messages:
anita (People Ops): Posting the follow-up from the all-hands headcount section and the Q&A thread. TL;DR: small reorg + 28 net new roles across infra/runtime/product over the next two quarters. Slides + headcount sheet here: https://short.link/allhands/headcount :wave:

sarah (CEO): Thanks — high level: we’re prioritizing runtime, Dedicated, and SRE to support bigger customers. Funding will go to those first.

jordan (Eng Manager): Can you share a quick breakdown by team? e.g., how many for eng-runtime vs eng-sre vs product?

anita (People Ops): Sure — numbers from the slide deck:
```
Q2:
- Eng-runtime: 10
- Eng-sre: 6
- Product: 4
- Devex: 3
- Sales/Customer Success: 5
```

lee (Recruiter): We’re kicking off reqs this week. For eng-runtime we’ll hire across L3-L7; prioritized reqs will be in Greenhouse.

vincent (Staff SWE): Quick q: are roles remote-first or region-specific? Is there an APAC plan?

anita (People Ops): Mostly US + EU. We’ll open a few APAC roles for CS and infra, but most runtime hires will be US to keep core infra collaboration tight.

olivia (Product): On the reorg: will PMs be reassigned to the new "Serving" product area or stay with their current squads?

mike (VP Eng): PMs — we’re creating a Serving squad that consolidates runtime + model-serving PMs. Short term you’ll be paired with engineering leads; long term expect 2 PMs to move and 2 new PM hires.

jordan (Eng Manager): Will on-call expectations change? We’ve had more paging recently and we’re worried about load during hiring ramp.

mike (VP Eng): Good call. On-call will be adjusted: Eng-sre headcount is intended to reduce per-person alert volume. We’ll also run a rotation backfill policy for hires during their first 90 days so teams aren’t overloaded.

vincent (Staff SWE): Will there be a leveling or calibration for existing ICs given new org mappings?

anita (People Ops): We’ll run a calibration cycle after the reorg. No mass level changes by default — promotions will follow our normal review cadence and be handled case-by-case.

recruit-bot: Reminder: job post templates updated -> https://gh/jobs/templates. Use the 'Serving' prefix for runtime roles.

lee (Recruiter): :thumbsup: Recruiters will flag 'priority' reqs for Q2 hires. Managers, please DM me with referrals so we can fast-track.

sarah (CEO): Budget question — are these net-new roles or mostly backfills? Curious about runway impact.

anita (People Ops): Mostly net-new (28). We’ll fund via Series C runway plus projected cost savings from infrastructure optimizations and headcount prioritization.

vincent (Staff SWE): Any change to contractor usage? We rely on contractors for some infra tasks.

mike (VP Eng): We’ll reduce contractor spend where hires are added; some contractors may be converted where it makes sense. No immediate mass conversions without manager + People Ops approval.

olivia (Product): Roadmap impact: should teams expect deliverable shifts because of the reorg?

sarah (CEO): Short-term some roadmap items might be re-prioritized. PMs and Eng leads will communicate any changes by EOD Friday.

jordan (Eng Manager): Timing — when do interviews start? When will we see people on the ground?

lee (Recruiter): Sourcing starts next week; first loop interviews are slated for 3-4 weeks after posting. Offers for prioritized roles targeted within 6-8 weeks, ramp depending on notice periods.

anita (People Ops): Thanks all — if you want 1:1 follow-up, book time with People Ops. I’ll update the org chart and drop the hires sheet in the all-hands drive once reqs are live. :party_parrot:
